findings.claim: ABNB Q3 2026 Nights and Seats Booked +16% YoY to 155.0M, fastest growth in four years (Q2 2026 was +10%); GBV $27.7B +21%; full-year 2026 revenue growth outlook raised to high teens. No 2027 guidance found.
findings.source: 247WallSt: Airbnb Q3 2026: Bookings Surge 16%, Full-Year Outlook Raised
findings.excerpt: growth of Nights and Seats Booked during Q3 2026 compared to Q3 2025—the highest growth we've seen in four years

findings.claim: AirDNA July 2026 midyear outlook: US short-term rental available listings growth cut from 4.6% (Dec 2025 forecast) to 2.7% for 2026, matching demand growth +2.7%, occupancy 57.4%. Local oversupply concentrated in fast-supply-growth markets (Florida beach). Source did not frame structural vs cyclical.
findings.source: AirDNA Midyear Outlook (July 8, 2026), via search summary

findings.claim: UK short-term rental supply kept growing YoY through June 2026 while nights reserved (5.8M) were broadly flat vs 2025 and below 2024.
findings.excerpt: In June 2026, 5.8 million nights were reserved in short-term rental properties, broadly in line with 2025 level but remaining below 2024.

note: Only 2 searches used. No 2027-2028 consensus demand outlook found; structural/cyclical framing is not stated by sources.
